# 1. Get counts

```{r}
# srun -p interactive --pty bash

library(DESeq2)
outdir = "/Users/sofiasalazar/Desktop/regulons/"
load("/Users/sofiasalazar/Desktop/regulons/data/vsd2.RData")
load("/Users/sofiasalazar/Desktop/regulons/data/LRT-dds.RData")
DGE <- res2
transcripts <- rownames(vsd2) 
new <- list()
for(i in 1:length(transcripts)){
  new[i] <- gsub("\\..*","", transcripts[i])
}
transcripts <- (unlist(new))

df <- as.data.frame(DGE)
df <- tibble::rownames_to_column(df, "ID")

name_short<-function(table){
  table$ID <- gsub("\\..*","", table$ID)
  return(table)
}

df <- name_short(df)

library("biomaRt")
mart <- useMart(biomart="ensembl", dataset="hsapiens_gene_ensembl")
genes <- getBM(attributes = c("ensembl_gene_id", "hgnc_symbol","transcript_biotype"),
               filters = c("ensembl_gene_id"), 
               values = df$ID,
               mart = mart)
names(genes)[1] <- "ID"
names(genes)[2] <- "gene_name"

keep <- c("lncRNA","miRNA","protein_coding","protein_coding_CDS_not_defined","snoRNA","snRNA")
new.genes <- subset(genes, transcript_biotype %in% keep)

dim(new.genes[unique(new.genes$ID),])
info <- new.genes[!duplicated(new.genes$ID),]
dim(info)
info <- (info[info$gene_name != "",])

unique_info <- info[!duplicated(info$gene_name), ]

keep.rownames <- unique_info$ID
length(keep.rownames)

counts <- as.data.frame(assays(vsd2))
counts <- counts[,-c(1,2)]

rownames(counts) <- transcripts

reduced.vsd <- counts[rownames(counts) %in% keep.rownames,]
# reduced.vsd$id <- rownames(reduced.vsd)
merged <- merge(info, reduced.vsd, by.x = "ID", by.y = "row.names")
rownames(merged) <- merged$gene_name

reduced.counts <- merged[ , !(names(merged) %in% c("ID", "gene_name", "transcript_biotype"))]


dim(reduced.counts)

write.table(reduced.counts, file = paste0(outdir, "data/reduced.counts.csv"), sep = ",", eol = "\n", na = "NA", row.names = T, col.names = T, quote = F)


```

# 2. Make loompy file

```{python eval = F}
import loompy
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os

print(loompy.__version__) # 3.0.6
PRE = "/Users/sofiasalazar/Desktop/regulons/"
file = os.path.join(PRE, "data/reduced.counts.csv")

# Read counts file
data = pd.read_csv(file)
# Define output file
loomfile = file.replace(".csv", ".loom")

# Create loompy file
matrix = np.array(data.values)
row_attrs = {"Gene" : list(data.index)}
col_attrs = {"CellID" : list(data.columns)}
loompy.create(loomfile, matrix, row_attrs, col_attrs)
```

# 3. Set up config file

```{bash eval=FALSE}
manifest {
   name = 'vib-singlecell-nf/vsn-pipelines'
   description = 'A repository of pipelines for single-cell data in Nextflow DSL2'
   homePage = 'https://github.com/vib-singlecell-nf/vsn-pipelines'
   version = '0.25.0'
   mainScript = 'main.nf'
   defaultBranch = 'master'
   nextflowVersion = '!>=20.10.0'
}

params {
   global {
      project_name = 'sle'
      outdir = '/mnt/data/amedina/ssalazar/regulons_SLE/out'
      seed = 777
      species = 'human'
      genome {
         assembly = 'hg38'
      }
   }

   misc {
      test {
         enabled = false
      }
   }

   utils {
      container = 'vibsinglecellnf/utils:0.4.0'
      publish {
         compressionLevel = 6
         annotateWithBatchVariableName = false
         mode = 'copy'
      }
   }

   sc {
      file_converter {
         off = 'h5ad'
         tagCellWithSampleId = true
         remove10xGEMWell = false
         useFilteredMatrix = true
         makeVarIndexUnique = false
         iff = 'loom'
      }

      scenic {
         container = 'aertslab/pyscenic:0.10.4'
         scenicoutdir = '/mnt/data/amedina/ssalazar/regulons_SLE/out/scenic/'
         filteredLoom = '/mnt/data/amedina/ssalazar/regulons_SLE/data/reduced_counts.loom'
         scenicOutputLoom = 'SCENIC_output.loom'
         scenicScopeOutputLoom = 'SCENIC_SCope_output.loom'

         mode = 'dask_multiprocessing'
         client_or_address = ''

         cell_id_attribute = 'CellID'
         gene_attribute = 'Gene'
         report_ipynb = '/src/scenic/bin/reports/scenic_report.ipynb'
         skipReports = false

         grn {
            algorithm = 'grnboost2'
            tfs = '/mnt/data/amedina/lupus/RNA_lupus/reg_networks/resources/allTFs_hg38.txt'
         }

         cistarget {
            adj = 'adj.tsv'
            type = ''
            rank_threshold = 5000
            auc_threshold = 0.05
            nes_threshold = 3.0
            min_orthologous_identity = 0.0
            max_similarity_fdr = 0.001
            annotations_fname = ''
            thresholds = '0.75,0.90'
            top_n_targets = 50
            top_n_regulators = '5,10,50'
            min_genes = 20
            all_modules = false

            motifsDb = '/mnt/data/amedina/lupus/RNA_lupus/reg_networks/resources/hg38__refseq-r80__*feather'
            motifsAnnotation = '/mnt/data/amedina/lupus/RNA_lupus/reg_networks/resources/motifs-v9-nr.hgnc-m0.001-o0.0.tbl'
            tracksDb = '/mnt/data/amedina/lupus/RNA_lupus/reg_networks/resources/encode_20190621__ChIP_seq_transcription_factor.hg38__refseq-r80__*feather'
            tracksAnnotation = '/mnt/data/amedina/lupus/RNA_lupus/reg_networks/resources/encode_project_20190621__ChIP-seq_transcription_factor.homo_sapiens.hg38.bigwig_signal_pvalue.track_to_tf_in_motif_to_tf_format.tsv'
         }

         aucell {
            output = 'aucell_output.loom'
            rank_threshold = 5000
            auc_threshold = 0.05
            nes_threshold = 3.0
            min_genes_regulon = 10
            min_regulon_gene_occurrence = 80
         }

         numRuns = 100

         aggregate_features {
            use_chunking = true
            output_format = 'csv'
            compression = 'gzip'
         }
      }

      scope {
         genome = ''
         tree {
            level_1 = ''
            level_2 = ''
            level_3 = ''
         }
      }
   }

   data {
      loom {
         file_paths = '/mnt/data/amedina/lupus/RNA_lupus/counts/reduced_counts.loom'
         suffix = '.loom'
      }
   }
}

process {
   executor = 'slurm'

   // Defaults razonables
   cpus = 2
   memory = '8 GB'
   time = '2h'
   errorStrategy = 'retry'
   maxRetries = 2

   // General scenic (no lo dejes en 1, si no se te serializa todo)
   withLabel:'compute_resources__scenic.*' {
      time = '24h'
      maxForks = 4
   }

   // ARBORETO/GRN = lo pesado, controla el paralelismo por tu QOS (~64 CPUs)
   withLabel:compute_resources__scenic_grn {
      cpus = 16
      memory = '150 GB'
      time = '24h'
      maxForks = 4
   }

   // CISTARGET suele ser pesado, pero no conviene competir con 4 arboretos; mantenlo moderado
   withLabel:compute_resources__scenic_cistarget {
      cpus = 8
      memory = '150 GB'
      time = '24h'
      maxForks = 2
   }

   // AUCELL suele ser más ligero
   withLabel:compute_resources__scenic_aucell {
      cpus = 8
      memory = '80 GB'
      time = '12h'
      maxForks = 2
   }

   // Multiruns aggregation: suele ser IO-heavy, no lo paralelices demasiado
   withLabel:'compute_resources__scenic_multiruns.*' {
      cpus = 4
      memory = '80 GB'
      time = '12h'
      maxForks = 1
   }
}

timeline {
   enabled = true
   file = '/mnt/data/amedina/ssalazar/regulons_SLE/scripts/logs/execution_timeline.html'
}

report {
   enabled = true
   file = '/mnt/data/amedina/ssalazar/regulons_SLE/scripts/logs/execution_report.html'
}

trace {
   enabled = true
   file = '/mnt/data/amedina/ssalazar/regulons_SLE/scripts/logs/execution_trace.txt'
}

dag {
   enabled = true
   file = '/mnt/data/amedina/ssalazar/regulons_SLE/scripts/logs/pipeline_dag.svg'
}

singularity {
   enabled = true
   autoMounts = true
   cacheDir = '/mnt/data/amedina/ssalazar/regulons_SLE/singularity'
   runOptions = '--cleanenv --bind /mnt/data/amedina/ssalazar/'
}
```

# 4. Install nextflow locally

```{bash eval=FALSE}
module purge
module load oracle-java/8u371
BASE="/mnt/data/amedina/ssalazar/regulons_SLE"
mkdir -p "${BASE}/bin"
mkdir -p "${BASE}/scripts/logs" 
mkdir -p "${BASE}/work" 
mkdir -p "${BASE}/out" 
mkdir -p "${BASE}/singularity" 
mkdir -p "${BASE}/.nextflow_home" 
mkdir -p "${BASE}/tmp"

cd "${BASE}/bin"
export NXF_VER=21.04.3
curl -fsSL https://get.nextflow.io | bash
chmod +x nextflow

# Verify

./nextflow -version

# Should be: version 21.04.3 build 5560
```

# 5. Run pipeline

```{bash eval=F}
sbatch "${BASE}/scripts/run_scenic.sbatch"
```
